description: This file contains implementation of RemindersTableManager class used for managing reminder entries stored in Azure Table Storage within the Orleans runtime. It also defines the ReminderTableEntry class representing individual reminder entries with associated utility methods for constructing keys and bounds.

classes.name: ReminderTableEntry
classes.description: Represents a reminder entry stored in Azure Table Storage, including key components like GrainReference, ReminderName, ServiceId, and utility methods for key construction.

classes.name: RemindersTableManager
classes.description: Manages reminder entries in Azure Table Storage, providing methods for querying, upserting, and deleting reminder entries.

methods.name: FindReminderEntries
methods.description: Finds reminder entries within a certain range of partition keys, handling wrap-around cases.

methods.name: FindReminderEntries (overload)
methods.description: Finds reminder entries associated with a specific GrainId.

methods.name: FindReminderEntry
methods.description: Finds a specific reminder entry based on GrainId and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: DeleteReminderEntryConditionally
methods.description: Deletes a reminder entry conditionally based on its ETag.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all reminder entries associated with the current service and deployment IDs.
